name: smoke-window
description: cart plays his recording into the Apartments, smokes the window over B at 15 s and walks to his recorded spot (within the spot tolerance from 18 s, over the recorded hit at 18.5 s), hidden from Lokier by the smoke: no encounter starts. At 19.3 s he steps west out of the smoke, still at the window: Lokier sees him, the scripted hit lands about 1 s later, and cart kills Lokier for real.
